message.reasoning: We need to navigate to temporary directory. In Unix, temp dir is /tmp. But we are in a virtual file system. We can use pwd to see current. Then cd? There's no cd tool. But we can use ls with path? The ls tool only lists current directory. There's no tool to change directory. But we can use find with path? But we can't change cwd. Maybe we can use ls with path? The ls signature: ls({a?: boolean}). No path param. So we cannot list arbitrary directories. But maybe we can use find to search? find has path param. But we want to list all files in /tmp. We can use find with path="/tmp" and name=None. That will return all items. But we also want hidden files. find will include hidden? It says it searches recursively. It doesn't mention hidden. But likely includes all. Let's try find.
